people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses returned to Yahweh, and said, “Lord, why have you brought trouble on this people? Why is it that you have sent me?
translations.bsb: So Moses returned to the LORD and asked, “Lord, why have You brought trouble upon this people? Is this why You sent me?
translations.kjv: And Moses returned unto the LORD, and said, Lord, wherefore hast thou so evil entreated this people? why is it that thou hast sent
translations.asv: And Moses returned unto Jehovah, and said, Lord, wherefore hast thou dealt ill with this people? why is it that thou hast sent me?
